title: Pentatonic Groove
body: The pentatonic scale (5 notes: C D E G A) is used in blues, rock, folk, and jazz worldwide. Every note works over almost any chord — which makes improvising feel magical.

title: Pentatonic Patterns
caption: The opening jumps C→E→G→A — not stepwise but in leaps. Leaps create energy; steps create smoothness. This groove mixes both to build momentum.
